blocks.text: Anthony Roquel, best known for portraying the role of Tonette Macho in the 1970s sitcom “Iskul Bukol,” has died of cancer at the age of 68, his family confirmed. Roquel’s demise was confirmed through a statement shared by his niece, Nica Gomez-Lorena, through her Facebook page on Friday, Oct. 16. “With faith and love, we share that our dearest, Tito Anthony A. Roquel, has been called home to be with our Lord and Savior on Oct. 16, 2026.
